title: docs(qa): re-point five 18.0 sweep red-row clauses to the shipped contract
body:
Refs #24579 (§1)
Clause-②: no

Part of #24579: this PR lands §1 of that wave anchor, the five red-row re-points. §2 (wave-wide themes), §3 (checklist-accuracy findings), §4 (fixture gaps, partials, not-run handover), §6 and §7 stay on the card.

## What

The 18.0 release sweep (subject `5b14b7f3`) scored five checklist clauses `fail`. Each run record disposed its row as a stale spec or an assertion defect against a documented contract: the product is right and the clause is wrong. This PR re-points those five clauses. Each item bumps `revision` 1 → 2 and gains one `history` row that names its run record and has this PR as its `ref`.

Ledger only. No product code, test or pin changes. Diff: 5 files under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/`, one item per file, and no other item or area-level key moves (checked by parse against the base).

| item · clause | run record | disposition | edited fields | revision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` acceptance[1]–[4] | #24551 (verdict word reconciled with #24556) | stale spec | title, `fixtures.knownGaps` (new), steps, acceptance[0]–[3] (old [4] removed), `automated.ref`, source | 1 → 2 |
| `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` acceptance[2] | #24545 (and #24558's "PUT 422 too broad") | stale spec | title, steps[1], acceptance[2] | 1 → 2 |
| `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` acceptance[2] | #24541 | assertion defect | acceptance[2] (acceptance[1] untouched: product defect #24561) | 1 → 2 |
| `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` acceptance[3] | #24559 | assertion defect | title, acceptance[3] | 1 → 2 |
| `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` acceptance[3] | #24560 | stale spec | title, steps (renumbered from 0), acceptance[1] (index), acceptance[3] | 1 → 2 |

## Each re-point, against `main` `5a871e4e41`

Every source cited below is byte-identical between the run subject `5b14b7f3` and `main` `5a871e4e41`. The one file that moved, `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, changed by a perf commit whose hunks are nowhere near the two refusals cited from it.

1. **`cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`.** By ruling, 18.0 is fresh installs only. The registered `os migrate organization-ownership` (`MigrateOrganizationOwnership`) refuses plan and apply alike, with `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` / `upgrade-unavailable`, before it opens anything. The changes:
   - acceptance[1] scores the bare-run refusal: no plan file, DB checksum unchanged.
   - acceptance[2] scores every `--apply` arm refusing the same way.
   - acceptance[3] keeps the drop-gate half (`refused_organization_ownership_unmigrated` with `tables`). The sys_migration checkpoint half is dropped.
   - Revision 1's acceptance[4] (the migrated copy boots) is removed.
   - `automated.ref` gains `organization-ownership.release-refusal.test.ts`, the pin of the registered command. The other seven pins drive the ceremony class beneath it.
   - **The mechanism (PM hypothesis 1, falsified):** the ledger has no clause-level skip. 1788 clauses across 16 areas carry only `clause`/`oracle`/`verify`/`evidence` (one `$comment`). `check-platform-checklist.mjs` reads no such key, and RUNNER's `skipped` is a run verdict, not an item field. The nearest legal shape is the one the ledger already uses for a half an item does not score: a `fixtures.knownGaps` line saying the half is deliberately not scored here. Precedents are `cli.plugin-manifest-build-contract` knownGaps[1] and `platform-core.manifest-install-contract` knownGaps[0].
   - **The knownGaps line:** `knownGaps[0]` lists the ceremony's withdrawn arms with the ruling quoted from #24551 ("ruling records 6259608309 (item 1) and 6259698357 then cut 18.0 to fresh installs on the single posture…"). It tells a runner to score those arms neither `fail` (#24551's reading of revision 1) nor `skipped` (#24556's, c1/c2/c4), because they are not on the item. That is the single reading for both runs: each run captured the refusal that each re-pointed clause now asserts.
   - `knownGaps[1]` says acceptance[3] scores the drop gate's exit, `message` and `tables`, not its prose. That prose still prescribes the withdrawn command, which is row 3 of #24567.
2. **`automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18`.**
   - **Root-scope arms:** `packages/lint/src/flow-cel-root-scope.ts#perWriteSnapshotEntrance` stands the CEL root-scope judgment down at the runtime publish gate. This is by design, under rulings 5791822697 (item 3) and 6104584601 (letter B), and the item's own pin `validate-expressions.flow-cel-root.test.ts` asserts it. So the `record.x` and `user.id` arms expect 200 and a stored row at PUT, and `os validate` (acceptance[1]) still refuses them.
   - **Job and endpoint arms:** these are not PUT /meta/flow bodies. `job` and `api` are code-only types (`allowRuntimeCreate: false`, so PUT answers 403 `NOT_CREATABLE`). The clause names the flow-side twins the door does refuse: a `try_catch` node's `retry.maxRetry`, and the `runAs: "system"` flow that a code-declared `authRequired: false` endpoint names (`anonymousElevatedFlowRefusal`, 422 at `runAs`).
3. **`api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`.** On a tenant-scoped object, driver-sql builds a field's `unique: true` as the `(organization, field)` composite, so the driver names no single column. `dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts` pins `details` keys as exactly `developerMessage` and `object`, and adds `field` only when `DuplicateRecordError` states a column. The clause now asserts that composite shape.
4. **`access-security.share-link-combined-gates`.** In `share-link-routes.ts#registerShareLinkRoutes`, `/messages` passes `resolveToken` the same audience inputs `/resolve` does. It answers every refusal with one `404 NOT_FOUND`, and a resolved non-`ai_conversations` link with `400 UNSUPPORTED`. `runtime/src/domains/share-links-messages-audience.test.ts` holds both mounts to one open/refused verdict per audience. The clause becomes "`/messages` is open iff `/resolve` is open", where open means the call passed the link's gates. A malformed password header is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` by both routes, before either reads the link.
5. **`attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity`.**
   - **Progress:** `registerStorageRoutes` asks the starting-organization gate on progress only when `expiryStampDue` holds. So after an org switch, progress answers 200 unless the session's `expires_at` has passed, and 409 after that. Chunk PUT and complete answer 409 either way.
   - **Numbering:** the steps numbered chunks from 1 while the API numbers them from 0 (the server answered `missingChunks: [1]` for the step's "chunk 2"). Steps now number from 0, acceptance[1] expects `[1]`, and the org-switch step names all three calls.

Titles that contradicted a re-pointed clause follow it: cli, automation, access-security and attachments. No `file:line` citation is written. The new `#symbol` anchors are `MigrateOrganizationOwnership`, `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`, `perWriteSnapshotEntrance`, `registerShareLinkRoutes` and `registerStorageRoutes`, and all five resolve.

## Verification (at `1f7239d717`)

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exits 0. This gate runs in no per-PR CI, so this local reading is its evidence:
  ```text
  check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 327 items (322 active, 1 planned); coverage: 39 kinds mapped, 2 waived; traps: 19 documented, 19 in use; … line citations: 0 survive across 21 swept documents …; symbol anchors: 860/870 resolved … across 21 swept documents against 406 cited sources, 10 on the named residual, 18 file floors held
  ```
  The symbol-anchor count was 855/865 against 404 cited sources at base `5a871e4e41`. This diff adds +5 resolved anchors and loses none, and the residual is unchanged at 10.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 13 commands on this diff (5 paths vs merge base `5a871e4e4`, +73 / −45). All 13 exit 0:
  - `check-ci-filter-parity`
  - `check-closing-keyword-parity` and its `--self-test`
  - `check-comment-mask-corpus`
  - `check:doc-formula-expressions` (lint). This one first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE: formula and lint unbuilt, nothing measured). It exits 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`.
  - `check:cross-package-test-inputs`
  - `check:doc-authoring`
  - `check:driver-memory-census`
  - `check:gitlink-declared`
  - `check:nul-bytes`
  - `check:platform-checklist`
  - `check:refd-timer-probe`
  - `check:watch-hint-literal`
- `--ran` reconciliation: "13 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 13 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 13 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- No package is touched, so there is no dependency-closure build, package test or typecheck. The rest of the farm is CI's.
- `skip-changeset`, re-measured: the only `package.json` whose directory contains `docs/qa/` is the private repo root (`@objectstack/spec-monorepo`, `private: true`), so this diff ships nothing.
- The PR opens with each new `history` row's `ref` set to a placeholder, because the PR number does not exist until the PR does. The next commit replaces those five strings with this PR's number and changes nothing else. The gate re-run on that final head is recorded in the `os-dev-report` comment on #24579.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed. Each item is already parked on #24579 by its run record unless another carrier is named.

- `access-security.share-link-combined-gates` `automated.ref` does not name `packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links-messages-audience.test.ts`, the pin of the parity acceptance[3] now asserts. Carrier: #24579 §3. Not added here, because §1 changes `automated.ref` for the cli row only.
- `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` acceptance[3] still needs a second organization, and stock 18.0 refuses one with 403 `ORGANIZATION_CREATION_DISABLED`. Carrier: #24579 §2, the "no second organization" theme. Separately, none of its three pins asserts the door-level org-switch 409. Carrier: #24579 §3, from #24560.
- `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` has three steps-level accuracy findings. Carrier: #24579 §3, from #24545 and #24558.
  - The anonymous-endpoint arm needs an armed `rateLimit`.
  - "A REST-triggered flow reading record.x" is ambiguous.
  - acceptance[1]'s schema-layer arms surface as `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` with a contract sentence, not as a rule id.
- `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`: a package cannot author a hook on `sys_sharing_rule`, so the fixture line and step 1 are unrunnable as written. Carrier: #24579 §3, from #24541 and #24558. acceptance[1] is the product defect #24561.
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`: there is no v17-shaped SQLite fixture in the tree. Carrier: #24579 §4. The drop-gate prose naming the withdrawn command is row 3 of #24567.
